source_snapshot.test_name_items: Set LAN source in static via BMC
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set LAN source by:
    - IPMI command - Send command: ipmitool lan set <Channel number> ipsrc static.
    - Web UI - Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "Network" -> Uncheck "Use DHCP".
2. Set static IP:
     - IPMI command -
          Send command: ipmitool lan set <Channel number> ipaddr <x.x.x.x>
          Send command: ipmitool lan set <Channel number> netmask <x.x.x.x>
          Send command: ipmitool lan set <Channel number> defgw ipaddr <x.x.x.x>
    - Web UI -
          Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "Network".
          Type IP address in the column of "IPv4 address".
          Type netmask in the column of "Subnet mask".
          Type default gateway IP address in the column of "Default Gateway".
3. Send command: ipmitool lan print to check LAN information.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC LAN should display correctly as setting.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 ipsrc static 2>&1; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 ipaddr "$DUT_IP" 2>&1; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 netmask 255.255.255.0 2>&1; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 defgw ip 2>&1; echo ---lan-print---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address Source|IP Address|Subnet Mask|Default Gateway"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: set ch1 LAN source to static with the target IP/netmask then return the FULL `ipmitool lan print` address lines so the user confirms the BMC shows the static IP exactly as configured.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: write to BMC network config (ipsrc static + IP) re-addresses the active BMC channel and can drop the current connection; confirm the static IP/network before applying and that it persists.

original_test_intent: Configure a conflict-free static IPv4 address, mask and gateway on the intended BMC channel and prove exact read-back, identity, reachability and persistence.
original_method: Use documented IPMI LAN set or WebUI, reconnect at the new address and read the LAN configuration.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies and approves the channel/address/recovery plan; the complete IPMI software path can execute and collect evidence automatically.
safety_requirements: Verify uniqueness, subnet and target identity before write.
Do not hard-code channel 1, /24 or credentials.
Do not automatically retry after loss of access.
Preserve old config and recover locally/OOB if necessary.
agent_execution_scope: Snapshot, apply mapped static values, rediscover/reconnect, validate read-back/routes/identity/persistence and roll back if planned.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Concept fits but channel, address and credentials are unsafe; default-gateway syntax is incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use mapped channel, validated ipmitool syntax and secret-safe authentication with preflight conflict checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Static source, IP/mask/gateway, IPMI/WebUI alternatives, script and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot current config, validate address plan, apply all static fields on the mapped channel, reconnect by new identity, verify persistence and restore if required.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC LAN channel and network.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds atomic plan validation, secure secrets and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves the actual static-network write and read-back.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Misconfiguration can strand BMC access or create an address conflict.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific address and channel are inputs; report actual values securely without changing the Master Source.
expected_evidence: Post-change lan print, MAC and reachability

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: IPMI and WebUI are equivalent allowed paths to one static state; no source contradiction exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Parameters and approval affect readiness, not software automation capability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Fixes unsafe placeholders and gateway command.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approval, execution, tool result and verdict.

review_improvement: Makes disruptive readdressing identity-safe, recoverable and fully evidenced.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPMI can perform every configuration/read-back/reconnect step programmatically; human approval and provided addresses do not make the software core partial.
